room1.description: You are in a large, poorly lit room. A door covered in ivy lies to the north of you. In the center of the room there is a large iron grate covering a sewer.

commands.description: The door is covered in ivy. It looks like it hasn't been opened in years.
You try to open the door, but it won't budge.
The grate is rusted and covered in slime. You see a shimmering object at the bottom of the sewer.
You lift the grate, a warm breeze carries the putrid smell of the sewer up to you.
You climb down into the sewer

sewer1.description: You are in a sewer. The walls are covered in slime and the water is up to your knees. You see a shimmering object in the water.

commands.description: The shimmering object is a key.

room2.description: You are in a room with three doors, atop the doors are crests. A lion, a snake, and a badger.
